_comment: sample-data 4.0.0 SqlTable predicates, Serializer 1.0.1-beta config schema (docs/configuration.md SqlTable predicate fields). Home: layers/sample-data/config/sample-data-2.4.json, which Compose-Edition unions into the composed Serializer.config.json (Compose-Edition.ps1:731-741, keyed mode|name). Every predicate is Merge: the layer is kind sample-data and ships only its own TC* rows. Order is FK-safe (parents first) and is also the harvest order; the engine re-sorts SqlTable entries by sys.foreign_keys at deserialize (SerializerOrchestrator.cs:405-429) and disables constraints per table while writing (SqlTableWriter.cs:407). Underscore keys are annotations: ConfigLoader uses default System.Text.Json options (ConfigLoader.cs:18) and ignores them, and Compose-Edition skips top-level _* keys (Compose-Edition.ps1:723). No nameColumn anywhere: file names come from the PK joined with $$, which keeps the base/cross-layer filename collision checks meaningful (base.contract.json). No serviceCaches: none of the eighteen DwCacheServiceRegistry names is verified for these tables; the host restart the layer already requires covers the caches. The two loose scripts the layer also ships (merge/_sql/demo-clock.sql, merge/_sql/email-stats.sql) are declared in layer.json sql[] and carry no predicate.

predicates.name: sample-data AccessUser
predicates._why: Merge: a re-deserialize must never reset a persona or the password UserSetPassword set. The identity key is written with IDENTITY_INSERT (SqlTableWriter.cs:45-64), so 100100..100103 survive. Password and runtime login columns are excluded; AccessUserPasswordSalt is deliberately absent because the column does not exist on DW 10.28.10 and a missing column fails config load.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomProductField
predicates._why: Merge: the six STANDARD product fields DW 10.28 keeps master-only by default (variantEditing=false) - ProductNumber, ProductPrice, ProductStock, ProductShortDescription, ProductMetaTitle, ProductMetaDescription. The layer ships 36 variant rows carrying their own number, price and stock, so a master save with variant editing OFF copies the master's values onto every variant (Foundry #1253, arm B). DW 10.28 stores the per-field setting as an EcomProductField ROW (ProductFieldAllowChangesAcrossVariants; ProductFieldIsStandard = 1 marks a settings row for a standard field), NOT in GlobalSettings.Ecom.config - the /Ecom/ProductLanguageControl/Variant/* nodes are the pre-migration store and DW carries a MigrationToDatabaseDone flag beside them. Measured on foundry.mydwsite4.com 2026-09-14: the table is EMPTY on a stock Swift 2.4 host and Admin API ProductAttributeSettingsSave CREATES one row per field. PKs are TCFIELD-namespaced (base.contract.json idRules) so the layer never collides with the FIELDnnn ids the EcomNumbers 'FIELD' counter mints, and the identities are in the layer's reserved range at/above the 100000 floor.
